claim.name: M7-E default thinking admission
claim.primary_problem: 现有已验证生产样本中 reasoning 约占 output 的一半，reasoning replay 还进入后续 input；当前默认 Auto 会启用 thinking，但没有同 binary 产品证据证明这部分成本带来相称 verified success。
claim.single_owner: crates/deepseek owns official reasoning planning, parsing and accounting; AgentRuntime and RunStore own exact request, event and terminal truth.
claim.treatment: 同一 immutable binary 仅把 StartRunCommand.reasoning_effort 从 high 改为 off；不修改模型、任务、工具目录、预算、Runtime、RunStore、completion 或 verifier。
claim.replacement: 只有全新正式 paired A/B 满足全部硬门禁和收益标准时，才把 production 默认从当前 Auto/thinking-enabled 收敛到 off；M7-E 未获得可采纳证据，因此不修改默认。
claim.cutover_deletion: 不新增产品模式、模型可见工具或 production treatment branch；M7-E hold 后只保留协议合同测试、manifest、ignored 0600 raw 和结论。

invalidated_formals.reason: v1 把成功 run_verifiers 的 conservative side_effect=indeterminate 错判为失败歧义；该 ToolOutcome 的 invocation/transport/operation 均成功、retry=not_needed、failure_code=null。

v2 把冻结 T3 明确要求的 deterministic verifier failure 错判为 unresolved side-effect ambiguity。该 outcome 是 accepted/succeeded/failed、failure_code=verifier_failed、retry=unsafe；随后只在有效 edit 后显式验证，Host temporal evidence、external verifier 与 terminal 均通过。
v3 的 T3-only allowlist 仍过窄：T4/off 首次实现 verifier_failed，随后经过第二次有效 edit→verifier success，最终 Host receipt、external verifier、scope 和 terminal 全通过；这是真实失败恢复，不是自动或原样重放。
invalidated_formals.latent_pairing_defect: 首个 ModelRequest.messages 含 Host-owned random task_generation/run ID；v4 因而新增精确单行归一化。

invalidated_formals.reason: T1、T2 两个完整 pair 在只归一化 task_generation 后 semantic messages hash 仍不同。只读定位证明 production workspace_revision 会绑定 canonical workspace/repository 绝对路径，而 v4 每个 arm 使用不同随机临时路径，因此实际 prompt identity 不同。
invalidated_formals.stop_evidence: 检测到第二个完整 pair 的同类 mismatch 后，外部 SIGINT 精确停止 evaluator；execute_arm finally 回收 app-server。active arm 可能已有未结算请求，无法从已删除的临时 State/RunStore 证明最终 billing，故 M7-E 禁止继续 live。
invalidated_formals.non_metric_diagnostic: 5/5 completed arms verified、false success 0、已完成 arm accounting 闭合；这些事实不能转化为产品 keep/efficiency 指标。

evaluator_v5_contract.fresh_suite: 若未来重新准入，v5 必须从 30 个全新 arm 开始，maximum_reruns=0；v1-v4 raw 保持 ignored、0600、不可覆盖，不补跑、不混入正式 product metrics。
evaluator_v5_contract.stable_pair_workspace: 同一 task/run_index 的 high/off 顺序 arm 复用 suite-owned fixed workspace path；每个 arm 从同一冻结 fixture 重建，arm 间精确删除该 slot 内容。State、RunStore、run ID 与 binary copy 保持各 arm 隔离。
evaluator_v5_contract.recovered_verifier_failure: 任一 accepted/succeeded/failed、side_effect=indeterminate、retry=unsafe、failure_code=verifier_failed 必须在同一 canonical outcome 序列中先出现后续成功 applied edit_file/apply_patch，再出现成功 run_verifiers；同时 verified、behavioral、measurement、scope、tool-authority、Host temporal verification 与 external verifier 全部有效。
evaluator_v5_contract.fatal_ambiguity: 未满足上述闭环的 verifier failure，以及其它 transport/operation/side_effect indeterminate 或 failure_code=side_effect_ambiguous，立即保存证据并中止。
evaluator_v5_contract.pair_identity: 首请求保留 raw messages hash，并另算只替换精确 task_generation 行的 semantic hash；替换计数必须恰为 1。pair 完成时立即比较 semantic messages、actor、system prompt、tools、max output、streaming、task fixture、binary 和 revision，不等待 30 arm 结束。
evaluator_v5_contract.live_gate: v4 外部停止留下 active arm unknown billing；v5 manifest 固定 live_api_admitted=false，Harness 在 preflight、output reservation和 Key read 之前失败。

source_identity.future_formal_revision_rule: 需要新的权威 re-admission manifest；不得把 v5 原地改为 live。新 formal revision 必须是包含 successor evaluator correction 的 clean HEAD，并冻结 suite-owned binary version/SHA/size。

prior_evidence.selection_reason: thinking high/off 是现有唯一可在同一 Standard Chat/tool catalog/binary 上形成明确 production treatment 的非编辑 surface；Writer 已正式负向，Strict/FIM 无 surface delta，incomplete-stream 已完成正确性切片但没有新产品 delta。

task_source.reuse_contract: Harness 只复用冻结任务、fixture、权限和 deterministic verifier 数据，不导入或降级历史 executor/event projector。

experiment.pairing: 同一 task/run_index 构成一对；pair 内 variant 先后按 run_index + task ordinal 奇偶平衡；同 pair 使用相同 absolute workspace slot，不替换失败 arm。
request_delta_allowlist: assistant content null/empty placeholder induced by reasoning replay

measurements: verified success, false success, first-attempt edit success and verifier recovery
root/read-only child request and retry counts
surface/model response counts and known cost
model turns, tool calls and typed tool failures
Host verifier receipt and latest workspace revision
external deterministic verifier and changed-file policy
crash/reopen exact request and RequestPlan evidence

admission.blocked_reason: v4 active arm was externally stopped after paired prompt identity mismatch; completed-arm accounting is known, but in-flight request billing cannot be reconstructed from the deleted per-arm State/RunStore.
pre_key: new explicit successor manifest resolves or accepts the prior unknown billing boundary
clean revision and immutable binary identity frozen
planner proves high/off only the allowlisted reasoning delta
exact high/off ModelRequest and RequestPlan rebuild after SQLite reopen
stable paired workspace produces exact semantic first-request identity
current Run API v10 and RuntimeEvent v16 Harness self-tests pass
all required offline Cargo gates pass
abort_suite_immediately: unknown billing, unpriced usage, unsealed or incomplete accounting
paired semantic prompt, surface, model, budget, retry, binary, revision, fixture or schedule mismatch
credential appears in argv, protocol, output, stderr, state or workspace
unresolved transport/operation/side-effect ambiguity, verifier failure without applied-write recovery, or output reservation ambiguity
admission.no_live_rule: M7-E v5 必须在 preflight、output reservation 和 Key read 前返回 live_api_not_admitted；不得调用官方 API。

hard_gates: 两个 variant 每个 task 均有 3 个全新正式 arm，maximum_reruns=0；v1-v4 evaluator-invalid arms 不计入
reasoning_off 每个 task verified success 不低于 reasoning_high
false success 不增加且两个 variant aggregate false success 均为 0
root/read-only child、权限、allowed paths、receipt、latest revision 与 external verifier 无关键回归
所有 response 均为 deepseek-v4-flash Standard Chat，high/off 除 reasoning treatment 外实际 prompt/request 语义身份相同
accounting sealed、complete、usage_complete、billing known、priced 且 totals 闭合
reasoning_off 的 reasoning_tokens 与 reasoning_replay_tokens 均为 0
一个 Runtime、RunStore、工具目录与 completion owner 保持唯一
acceptance.benefit: verified success 相同或更高时，15 个 pair 中至少 12 个 dual-success，且 input+output tokens、known cost、physical requests 或 wall time至少一项 paired median 改善不低于 15%；其余核心效率指标 paired median 回退不超过 10%。
acceptance.m7_e_decision: hold：没有可采纳的 30-arm formal；v4 还留下 active-arm unknown billing。production 默认维持不变。
